manifests.inst-pymolt-eval.sh:
cd /work
export DISABLE_BCOLZ_AVX2=1 MAKEFLAGS=-j1
pip install -q --only-binary :all: -r lock-slim-pymolt-eval.txt pytest 2>&1 | tail -3
# per-package fallback: build sdists one at a time
while read l; do [ -z "$l" ] && continue; pip install -q --no-deps "$l" 2>&1 | tail -1; done < lock-slim-pymolt-eval.txt
pip install -q pytest
pip list | wc -l

locust._note: Noisy pilot #1 (gevent/greenlets, ZeroMQ). Base = locust a7832cb5, the commit before PR #2411 (explicit 3.12 support, CI/config only). Both sides pin dependencies as of 2023-10-04, the migration date: the container install and the target manifest use --exclude-newer, which also keeps old gevent buildable (today's Cython cannot compile it). Step 0 (no pymolt): 4 runs, identical per-test outcomes, 349 passed, test_cpu_warning fails everywhere (host CPU) and is deselected. test_stop_timeout_with_interrupt_no_reschedule is timing-sensitive: it failed once in 5 uncaptured runs (passed in all 4 step-0 runs), so it is deselected too. test_distribute_users (a hard 7.0 s budget) and test_distributed_shape_with_fixed_users pass uncaptured but go over their wall-clock budgets under a capture that traces the stdlib (about 1.3x), so they are deselected: the pilot measures what pymolt reports, not whether a timing budget survives a tracer. test_command_line_arguments_override_config_file fails on 3.8 without pymolt when it runs after the other files (ReferenceError on a weakref, order-dependent), so it is deselected. Both sides take --confcutdir=. --rootdir=. (verify compares the two commands, so they must match): locust's pyproject has no pytest section, so pytest takes the outer repository as rootdir and the --deselect node ids silently match nothing.
